summary: PWA installability fix verified (frontend only). manifest.json valid (name, short_name, start_url /kasir, scope /, display standalone, icons 192/512 any + 512 maskable). All icon URLs return 200 image/png with correct pixel sizes (192x192, 512x512, 512x512, apple-touch 180x180). index.html links manifest, icon and apple-touch-icon. SW /service-worker.js registered (scope /), controller non-null after one reload, has fetch handler. CDP Page.getInstallabilityErrors returned [] and Page.getAppManifest errors []. beforeinstallprompt did NOT fire in headless Playwright (window.__installPrompt=false) - expected in headless/automation (no user engagement / no install UI), not an app bug. 'Pasang Aplikasi' button visible in sidebar; with no prompt it opens install-help-modal with Chrome/Edge, Android, iPhone, Firefox instructions; X close and backdrop click both close it. Standalone emulation (matchMedia override) shows install-status-installed and hides the button. Regression: offline reload of /kasir renders with offline banner and cached products; online cash checkout (Indomie, cash 5000, change 1500) succeeded and receipt shown.

issues: Two <meta name='theme-color'> tags (#000000 at line 6 and #059669 at line 29); browsers use the first, so title bar/browser chrome is black instead of brand emerald. Remove the #000000 one.
